subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: If If completions are awaited while the wake channel or its backstop is itself dead, misconfigured, or silent — an await's age exceeding the configured staleness bound with no resume delivered, then the system shall make the silence loud: the awaited set and each await's age shall be readable from repo/ledger state (FR-13's registration), and any lane state read (NFR-5's pattern) or drive touchpoint observing the exceeded bound shall surface a named wake-staleness defect — an unresumed await past its bound is a defect, never a resting state
intent: a named wake-staleness defect at the next state read or touchpoint, naming the stale await and its age
fit_criterion: staleness drill: with both delivery paths disabled and the bound exceeded, the state-read drill surfaces the named defect from repo data alone; no surface reports healthy
